Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30653-03.html.text: Sir Aaron Tanford: So the unfortunate knight was not able to recover his honor. Was this tear of return the only thing that remained? What a dreadful curse! So it is his fate to wander the Wastelands forever... He has no one to blame but himself. Well done! You have completed the task successfully.…

Q00212_TrialOfDuty/30653-04.html.text: Sir Aaron Tanford: You will learn the second part of the trial when you visit Sir Kiel Nighthawk . He is in the Dark Elf Guild of the Town of Dion . I shall pray to Einhasad for the successful completion of your tasks.

Q00224_TestOfSagittarius/30653-01.html.text: Sir Aaron Tanford Nice to meet you, young Warrior. I am Aaron Tanford, watchdog of the Wastelands. My mission is to stop the brutes that are terrorizing the villagers...

Q00224_TestOfSagittarius/30653-03.html.text: Sir Aaron Tanford I fear for Hunter Brankel, but what worries me more is what those heathen may do with the remains of Beleth... I must stay here, so I beseech you, go to the Ant's Nest of the Wastelands and find out what is going on there.
